version_checks: ICTPL 2018: TAMP/11/2018-ICTPL; order 31 July 2018; Gazette 342 dated 11 September 2018; approved Annex III. ICTPL 2020: same case; order 8 September 2020; Gazette 411 dated 6 October 2020; section 6.1 extends retrospectively from 1 April 2020 through 31 March 2021 or earlier stated triggers.

BPCL 2021: TAMP/59/2019-BPCL; order 15 September 2021; Gazette 419 dated 28 September 2021. Section 14.2: effective after 30 days from Gazette notification, three-year term subject to annual indexation, lapse unless specifically extended. It does not alone establish every clause current in 2026.

BPCL 2026: notice 3 April 2026; indexation 0.39%; revised rates from 1 May 2026 onwards. Do not derive a closed expiry date solely from its 26-27 filename. CRC, wharfage, pipeline, loading-arm and service rows are distinct from ordinary berth hire. Overstay is separately labelled a penalty.

JNPA 2026: notice 17 April 2026; explicit validity 1 May 2026 through 30 April 2027. Identical primary PDF to prior independent review. Ordinary berth table is hourly; craft daily composite charges and priority, penal, readiness and idling conditions remain distinct.
